import os,time
n=128
t=time.monotonic_ns()
for i in range(n):
 p=os.fork()
 if p==0: os._exit(0)
 assert os.waitpid(p,0)==(p,0)
print('BENCH_FORK_OK', (time.monotonic_ns()-t)/1e6, flush=True)

import os,time
n=128
t=time.monotonic_ns()
for i in range(n):
 parent=os.getpid()
 p=os.fork()
 if p==0:
  os.execve('/bin/true',['true'],{'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LC_ALL':'C'})
  os._exit(127)
 assert os.getpid()==parent
 assert os.waitpid(p,0)==(p,0)
print('BENCH_EXEC_OK', (time.monotonic_ns()-t)/1e6, flush=True)
